snippet.title: Ghostly Acres // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336610

Ghostly Acres is an incremental hotel management game that lets you play at your own pace. Build, collect, upgrade, and grow an old house into a thriving inn for ghostly travelers.

Developed by 
Baluster Games aka @Baluster Games
